name: sshi_fbr
rationale: The reference FBR fails on heavy loads (S2, S4) due to diode drops and on strong excitation (S3) due to lack of regulation. I am adding a Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit in parallel with the piezo to flip the capacitor voltage at each extremum, which significantly increases the extracted energy and average output voltage. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output voltage to 3.3V, preventing it from exceeding the 3.6V limit in S3.
